value.rationale: The complete height-two 2×m incidence algebra is the smallest nontrivial family with rank-two idempotent commutators, since single-bottom-row algebras have rank at most one. The exact positive-rank strata detect and quantify the noncommutativity of projections, including a sharp width threshold and a limiting generic-rank law. The object and invariant are intrinsic; the formulas are not just another finite computation or a relabeling of a known one-idempotent count.
